subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: Vitamin C deficiency in humans leads to a disease called:
explanation: Vitamin C deficiency causes scurvy (bleeding gums, weakness). Rickets is from Vitamin D deficiency; beriberi from B1 deficiency; pellagra from niacin (B3) deficiency.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch26 — General Science
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: Sir C.V. Raman won the Nobel Prize in Physics (1930) for his discovery related to:
explanation: C.V. Raman discovered that light changes wavelength when scattered by a molecule — the 'Raman Effect', winning him the 1930 Nobel Prize, the first for an Asian in the sciences.

subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: The closest star to Earth, providing us with light and heat, is the:
explanation: The Sun is Earth's closest star (~150 million km away). Proxima Centauri is the next-closest star system beyond our own, roughly 4.2 light-years away.
